subject: expression: Move more methods from `SessionVars` to `BuildContext` (#52440)
summary: Reviewed fab13afa2 vs its parent, limited to expression/planner/sessionctx changes: `StmtCtx.InNullRejectCheck` and BuildContext `Value/SetValue`-based state are replaced with explicit `BuildContext` APIs (`(Is|Set)InNullRejectCheck`, `(Is|Set)InUnionCast`, `AllocPlanColumnID`) implemented in `ExprCtxExtendedImpl`. Call sites (`isNullRejected`, `EvaluateExprWithNull`, `BuildCastFunction4Union`, constant folding) consistently use the new APIs and add nesting guards to avoid premature flag reset. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in SQL semantics, session/stmt behavior, or planner correctness within the scoped changes.
